purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Official public map page and JavaScript expose a Mouza map selector and PBF vector-tile layer. The public Jashore selector returned only an ongoing RS survey and no Thana list for the selected inputs; the route to individual Mouza/sheet is unresolved. Vector tiles are not retained as full parcel polygons.
registryAssessment: The official Jessore Zonal Settlement Office publishes Khatian and Mouza-map services; the Ministry of Land Records and Surveys portal offers map display and Khatian search, and states that it displays ongoing survey-stage records. The official district service catalogue describes certified Khatian and Mouza-map copies as application/fee-based. This confirms local survey/record services, not open full feature geometry.
